title: Editing Large Language Models with Geometry-Aware Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2611.06185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge editing has become a key technique for updating knowledge in large language models. However, existing methods neglect the geometric structure of the knowledge representation space, leading to two key limitations: they cannot distinguish which pre-trained knowledge should be preferentially preserved (core vs. non-core) nor which new edits are inherently difficult (hard vs. easy). To address this, we propose GEdit, a geometry-aware framework built on a Low-Rank Plus Diagonal (LR+D) factor model that captures the intrinsic low-rank structure of Transformer FFN hidden representations. GEdit features two complementary mechanisms. First, the low-rank regularization applies targeted protection on a low-rank core knowledge subspace. translated_title: 基于几何感知正则化的大型语言模型编辑
translated_abstract: 知识编辑已成为更新大型语言模型知识的关键技术。然而，现有方法忽视了知识表示空间的几何结构，导致两个关键局限：它们既无法区分哪些预训练知识应被优先保留（核心知识 vs. 非核心知识），也无法区分哪些新编辑请求本质上较为困难（困难编辑 vs. 简单编辑）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GEdit，一个基于低秩加对角（LR+D）因子模型的几何感知框架，该模型能够捕捉Transformer前馈网络（FFN）隐藏表示的内在低秩结构。GEdit包含两个互补机制：首先，低秩正则化对低秩核心知识子空间施加针对性保护；其次，自适应正则化根据每个编辑请求的可编辑性动态调整正则化强度——对困难编辑放松约束以确保编辑成功，对（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出GEdit框架，通过低秩加对角（LR+D）因子模型捕捉知识表示的几何结构，利用低秩正则化保护核心知识子空间，并依据编辑难度自适应调整正则化强度，实现更精准的大模型知识编辑。
en_tdlr: GEdit is a geometry-aware knowledge editing framework that uses a Low-Rank Plus Diagonal (LR+D) factor model to protect core knowledge subspaces via low-rank regularization and adaptively adjust regularization strength based on edit difficulty, enabling more precise knowledge editing in large language models.
